title: Price Paid per Tire for Treadwear Credits — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty
content:
The price paid per tire on a Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty treadwear adjustment credit follows how the set's ticket was paid and whether it received the line's set instant savings (4 or more tires of the line on one ticket).

| Set's ticket | Price paid per tire |
|---|---|
| charged to a Crestline Fleet Account | the price per tire, less the set instant savings divided by the tire count when the ticket had at least 4 tires, less the fleet discount taken on the tires invoice posted for the vehicle on the purchase date divided by the tire count |
| paid by any other tender, with at least 4 tires and the set instant savings received | the price per tire less the set instant savings divided by the tire count |
| any other ticket | the price per tire |

**The fleet discount on a tires invoice.** The discount on a Crestline Fleet Account tires invoice is one percentage taken on every discountable line of the ticket, the tire price, the mounting and the valve-stem or TPMS-kit lines alike. Wherever the tire price paid takes it off, the whole discount amount of that invoice is counted against the tire price, the part taken on the mounting and kit lines included, because those lines are never figured below the line's own charges here; a ticket of an ordered set carries the tire price alone.

| Line | Set instant savings per ticket |
|---|---|
| Crestline Value Touring 40K Treadwear Warranty | $0.00 |
| Crestline All-Season 50K Treadwear Warranty | $40.00 |
| Crestline Grand Touring 60K Treadwear Warranty | $60.00 |
| Crestline Highway Terrain LT 65K Treadwear Warranty | $50.00 |
| Crestline Premium Touring 75K Treadwear Warranty | $80.00 |
| Crestline Ultra Touring 85K Treadwear Warranty | $100.00 |

**Worked (hypothetical 4-tire tickets at $150.00 a tire on a line with $60.00 set savings):** paid by card — $150.00 less $15.00, $135.00; charged to a fleet account whose tires invoice shows a $48.00 discount — $150.00 less $15.00 less $12.00, $123.00; a 2-tire ticket paid in cash — $150.00.
